draft.subject: Following up on your note about cancellation timing
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for raising the cancellation timing question — your ticket is open with us and Tariq is following up directly. To confirm the one thing I can: a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately.

While that's in motion, if it's useful, I'm happy to spend 15 minutes with you this week on getting a first project set up — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — so you can judge Wrenfield on your team's real work before deciding. Just say the word and I'll send a time.

Best,
Priya
